articles.title: Bitcoin rally has more room as volatility shorts unwind, Two Prime CEO says

articles.title: Tracking cocoa may be just the beginning for PwC, Merck, Hashgraph provenance system
articles.snippet: The firms say their combination of physical authentication, digital traceability and enterprise process design has no precedent in supply chains, and cocoa is just the start.

articles.title: Hunter Biden debuts 'LAPTOP' memecoin targeting TRUMP holders
articles.snippet: LAPTOP debuts Wednesday on Base, with nearly a third of the supply set to be burned if a slate of political and market outcomes — including a Democratic win in 2028 — comes good.

articles.title: Ledger CTO urges AI bug hunter responsibility, warns against ‘attention farming’
articles.snippet: Ledger and Trezor said researchers have a responsibility to publish their findings if vendors fail to fix bugs within an agreed disclosure window.

articles.title: US Police Fear Meta Glasses Are Watching Them Back: Report
articles.snippet: Memos from the NYPD to Homeland Security warn the devices could be used for covert filming inside jails and police facilities.
